lines.text: At the LORD's command, Moses recorded the stages, and Israel left Rameses defiantly while Egypt buried its firstborn.
Israel crossed through the sea and camped at Marah, then reached Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees.
They camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
Israel camped at Mount Sinai, where Aaron the priest died at the LORD's command at age 123.
Israel camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Bethel.
